SELECT b.board_id AS board_id, b.title AS title, c.name AS category_name, b.project_name AS project_name, b.content AS content, b.participant_limit AS participant_limit, COUNT(DISTINCT pp.project_participant_id) AS participant_cnt, b.created_at AS created_at, COUNT(DISTINCT bl.board_like_id) AS like_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT co.comment_id) AS comment_cnt, b.main_image_path AS main_image_path FROM board b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN board_like bl ON b.board_id = bl.board_id LEFT JOIN comment co ON b.board_id = co.board_id LEFT JOIN project_participant pp ON b.board_id = pp.board_id GROUP BY b.board_id, c.name ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.board_id, b.project_name, b.title, b.content, b.rating, b.main_image_path, b.created_by, b.created_at, c.name FROM board b JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE b.board_id = #{board_id}

SELECT * FROM board b LEFT JOIN project_stack ps ON b.board_id = ps.board_id WHERE 1=1
AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ps.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND b.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND (LOWER(b.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(b.content) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(ps.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%')) OR LOWER(b.project_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%'))
SELECT * FROM board WHERE board_id < #{board_id} ORDER BY board_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM board WHERE board_id > #{board_id} ORDER BY board_id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM board WHERE created_by = #{email} ORDER BY created_at DESC
